title: Odd BLR Corrected Fourier Maximum Bound
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $f$ map the sign cube $\\{-1,1\\}^n$ to $\\{-1,1\\}$. The odd BLR acceptance probability is at most $\\frac12+\\frac12 M$, where $M$ is the maximum of $0$ and the Fourier coefficients $\\widehat f(S)$ over all odd-cardinality subsets $S\\subseteq[n]$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a sign-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
